excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a paleontologist, curly black hair, Black race, wearing a white sun hat. Wears a light purple tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and black hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Brushing Overburden from a Fragile Non-Avian Theropod Nest

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_3, wearing his signature white sun hat, uses a fine-bristled field brush to sweep away loose sediment from a block of dark green-grey siltstone matrix. His delicate sweeps expose a pair of elongated, finely textured eggs within a pristine Troodon nesting clutch on an open woodland floodplain. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
